# Example prompt

A prompt template is reusable text you paste to kick off a common task. Copy this
file, rename it, fill the blanks.

Target project: `<alias>` (resolved via `registry.json`).
Goal: `<what to build/fix>`.
Context: `<why / constraints / out-of-scope>`.

Plan briefly, make surgical changes, run the smallest relevant build/test, report results.
